question: The ice compartment in a refrigerator is 36 cm deep, 16 cm high and 12 cm wide. How many ice cubes will it hold, if each cube is 4 cm as its edge?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the dimensions of the compartment are perfectly divisible by the cube edge, calculate directly:

Number of cubes = (Depth ÷ edge) × (Height ÷ edge) × (Width ÷ edge)

Number of cubes = (36 ÷ 4) × (16 ÷ 4) × (12 ÷ 4)

Number of cubes = 9 × 4 × 3 = 108

**∴ The correct answer is 108 cubes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of the ice compartment = 16 cm

Width of the ice compartment = 12 cm
